accountBullets: Users must provide accurate and complete information when registering in the GlowUp app.
Users are responsible for keeping their login details confidential and must not share them with any third party.
GlowUp management reserves the right to suspend or cancel any account that violates the terms or misuses the service.
paymentBullets: Users must pay all fees related to services provided through the GlowUp app using available methods (bank cards, e-wallets, bank transfer, etc.).
All payments are final and non-refundable except in cases determined by the app management.
usageBullets: Users must use the GlowUp app for lawful purposes only.
It is prohibited to use the app for any illegal activity, harming others, or violating local/international laws.
The app may be modified or updated from time to time to improve service without prior notice.
